degree_rationale: New buds in the elements — molded and destroyed; warmth and cold nourish or starve; affliction comes through Hyle's energeia inundating crops. Treats the natural mechanism of vegetation-growth and failure.
direction_rationale: Inward processing of natural vegetation as receiving-and-being-destroyed — Hyle's shadow inundating. Reflective natural ecology.
grand_man_function: Natural vegetation-reception — buds receiving life or failure.
title: The buds in elements and why some are sweet, some bitter
